notes.title: Two challenge settings. Improvements for boss tiles.
notes.content:
The game now has two challenge settings.
[olist]
 Setting 1 is a bit easier by providing 1 free worker at the start of turns 2, 4 and 6. And +1 logistics and +1 food for free at the start of turns 3, 5 and 7.
 Setting 2 is the same game as it has been so far.
 Player level is stored separately for each challenge setting. 
[/olist]
Added a tutorial regarding challenge settings.
Changed "Rift to Plane of Fire" to not cost a material for activation and to produce one extra crystal per activation.
Changed "Stonehenge" to not cost a material for activation and to produce one extra crystal per activation.
Changed "Rift to Plane of Water" to produce one extra card per activation.
Changed "Rift to Plane of Air" to produce one extra crystal per activation.

notes.title: v0.017. Spanish translation. Minor bugfixes
notes.content:
Full translation to spanish.
Improve detection of mouseover for blinking active units.
Fix bug : do not cancel phantom warrior when battle is cancelled.
Fix bug : recover crystals spent when battle is cancelled.

notes.title: Update v0.016 . Magic crystals production increase and aventurers improvements.
notes.content:
This update brings two major changes. An increase in magic crystal production which has the goal of promoting the use of magic. And buffs to red magicians, archers and mystics so that they don't become underwhelming in higher levels.


Background image for the main game screen. Can revert to old plain color in Options.
Raised maximum Player Level to 30. From level 23 onwards all races are eligible and bonus/penalty is applied for less/more frequently used ones. See tutorial "High Level".
Red magicians can now improve their fire attack making it ultra hot. This adds extra attack which not even fire resistance can block. To activate this skill a card icon needs to be clicked in the battle screen to move it to the Attackers column. The number of cards that can be activated this way cannot exceed the number of attacking red magicians neither the number of cards in hand. At the end of a victorious combat that number of cards is discarded from hand. Chosen randomly and providing no benefit for the discard. The extra attack increases with Player Level. The formula for the extra attack is floor((4+player_level*num_cards_used)/10)
 Poison now also adds attack. Poisonous monsters have had their base attack lowered to compensate though but by a smaller amount than the gain from poison.
 Archers have become better at questing. When the last archer needed for a quest is spent it is exhausted instead of removed and an archer quest is drawn.
 Increased the generation of magic crystals in most hexes which produce crystals. Desert nomads and Pixies now start with more magic crystals than before.
 Added missing graphic to Surveyor hex.
 Increased cost of spell Magical Banquet from 1 to 2.
 Reduced the cost of spell Transcendence. But its effect now uses 2 magic crystals per earned renown (it was 1 per renown), to a maximum of 20 crystals for 10 renown.
 Spell magical forge now provides 1 material instead of 3.
 Updated and added tutorials about the new or changed game mechanics.

notes.title: Update V0.015
notes.content: Birdmen's improved so that adventurers can move from an hex with no monster to any hex adjacent to an explored hex with no monster.

notes.title: Update V0.014
notes.content:
Fix "Quest: Remove a minor curse". Now it costs only 1VP.
Change how Prison hexes work. Now an active worker appears automatically when the monster is defeated. And can also get a 2nd exhausted worker by using an adventurer.
Fixed typo in Prison.
All minor monster are revealed at start of game instead of 6. This affects new games but not games started with earlier versions.
New land card : Farseer.
New land card : Surveyor.
Fix bug with hexagons with abilities which depend on player level (like Mountains).
Different colors for hexagon cursors for : Starvation, divination abilities and casting spells from the 3 different schools of magic.
Reduced cost of "Quest: Build Roads" to 2xLogistics.
New Quest : Build a Shipyard

notes.title: Hotfix V0.013
notes.content:
Quests now correctly display their base terrain after loading a savegame.
    Lands did not save their general terrain type. This was needed for lands with variable types like Explorer's Guild. The type is now saved and loaded. Unfortunately when loading a V0.012 savegame it is not possible to know what the type was so a new one which is valid is assigned, this has almost no effect in game play though.

notes.title: Update V0.012
notes.content:
- Map hexagons are now displayed with different graphics for each specific land.
- When drawing a land or a quest you get to chose among 3 lands or 3 quests.
- Support portable mode.
- Renamed Rift to Plane of Earth as Stonehenge.
- Renamed Colosseum as The Temple.
- Renamed Caravans Market as Pyramid.
- Fixed a but about guild chooser.
- Added a tutorial screen about card drawing choosing to Tutorial : Basics.

notes.title: Update v0.010 Allow hiding the tutorial screen.
notes.content:
A button has been added to the tutorial screen to allow minimizing it. This allows viewing the whole game screen.
Added clarification to the tutorial about discarding cards.
